description: Form-associated time input with combobox text entry and a spinbutton popup

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name. A name on the inner input (the no-JS path) moves here on upgrade so exactly one value submits; the host's own name wins if both are set.

attributes.name: data-format
attributes.description: Force a 12- or 24-hour display. Default: the hour cycle of the nearest [lang] (else the browser locale).

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the text input and clock button, closes the popup and drops the value from submission. Observed at runtime; a disabled ancestor fieldset has the same effect. A disabled on the inner input moves here on upgrade.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Makes a time required (valueMissing while empty). Observed at runtime; a required on the inner input works too.

attributes.name: data-label-input
attributes.description: Accessible name for the text input when neither a <label> nor an aria-label/aria-labelledby is present.

attributes.name: data-label-toggle
attributes.description: Accessible name for the clock button.

attributes.name: data-label-dialog
attributes.description: Accessible name for the spinner popup (role=dialog).

attributes.name: data-label-hours
attributes.description: Accessible name of the hours spinbutton.

attributes.name: data-label-minutes
attributes.description: Accessible name of the minutes spinbutton.

attributes.name: data-label-seconds
attributes.description: Accessible name of the seconds spinbutton.

attributes.name: data-label-period
attributes.description: Prefix of the AM/PM button's accessible name ("AM/PM: PM"). The AM/PM text itself comes from Intl.

attributes.name: data-label-empty
attributes.description: Spinbutton value text while no time is set.

attributes.name: data-label-required
attributes.description: Validation message when required and empty. A data-message-valuemissing on the inner input wins.

attributes.name: data-label-range-underflow
attributes.default: Choose a time at or after {time}
attributes.description: Validation message when before min; {time} is the formatted min. A data-message-rangeunderflow on the inner input wins.

attributes.name: data-label-range-overflow
attributes.default: Choose a time at or before {time}
attributes.description: Validation message when after max; {time} is the formatted max. A data-message-rangeoverflow on the inner input wins.

attributes.name: data-label-step-mismatch
attributes.default: Choose a valid time. The nearest are {lower} and {upper}
attributes.description: Validation message when off the step grid; {lower}/{upper} are the nearest valid times. A data-message-stepmismatch on the inner input wins.

events.name: time-picker:change
events.description: Fired when the value changes (not on form reset/restore, not when a commit leaves it unchanged). value is 'HH:MM' or 'HH:MM:SS', '' when cleared (hours/minutes/seconds are then null). source is 'api' for .value assignments, 'pointer' for spinner/AM-PM clicks, 'keyboard' for typed commits and spinner keys.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Get or set the time as 'HH:MM' (or 'HH:MM:SS' when seconds are shown). '' when unset; assigning '' or null clears; malformed values are ignored.

properties.name: validity
properties.description: Current validity, owned by the host: valueMissing, rangeUnderflow, rangeOverflow (both for a value outside an overnight range), stepMismatch. Anchored on the text input.

properties.name: willValidate
properties.description: Whether the element is a candidate for constraint validation

methods.name: checkValidity()
methods.description: Run constraint validation without showing UI

methods.name: reportValidity()
methods.description: Run constraint validation and show the browser message, anchored on the text input

childAttributes.name: value
childAttributes.description: Initial time (HH:MM[:SS]). The value attribute is the form-reset target; omit it for an empty field.

childAttributes.name: min
childAttributes.description: Earliest valid time. Spinners stay at or after it; a typed earlier time is kept and flagged rangeUnderflow. A min later than max is an overnight range.

childAttributes.name: max
childAttributes.description: Latest valid time. Spinners stay at or before it; a typed later time is kept and flagged rangeOverflow.

childAttributes.name: step
childAttributes.description: Step in seconds (default 60; 'any' disables step checks), counted from min. Spinners snap to it; typed off-step times are flagged stepMismatch. Under 60 (or not a whole minute) shows a seconds spinner; whole hours (3600, 7200…) step the hours spinner and make minutes read-only.

childAttributes.name: name
childAttributes.description: Submission name for the no-JS fallback. Moved to the host on upgrade.

structure.description: Required. Supplies value/min/max/step and is the no-JS fallback. Its <label for> (or a <label for> on the host, or an aria-label) names the generated combobox.
